name: Nic Carroll
headline: Visionary Executive Leader
summary: I've led the whole of information technology as a CIO, CTO, and CISO, and today I lead Information Security and Identity and Access Management at Georgia Southern University. I'm a visionary problem solver who makes sure projects are completed on time, at scale, and under budget. I excel at creating new tools, processes, and procedures, including AI tools that are reimagining how a security department works.

experience.title: Chief Information Security Officer
experience.blurb: Leads Information Security and the Identity and Access Management group, protecting data integrity and operational resilience for 33,500 students and nearly 4,000 faculty across a global campus network. Uses AI tools built in house to reimagine how the security department works.

bullets.t: Led the GCC High research enclave, a segregated Microsoft 365 GCC High and Azure Government environment for Controlled Unclassified Information and export controlled (ITAR and EAR) data, through its CMMC Level 2 assessment, achieving a perfect score.

Built a unified dashboard that brings every Information Security and IAM application into one view, improving visibility across the environment and speeding the resolution of threats and vulnerabilities.
Building AI tools and resources to reimagine the Information Security department's processes, reporting, and daily operations.
Lead the Identity and Access Management group in addition to Information Security, aligning identity, provisioning, and access controls with security strategy.
Led a complete revision of the third party application review process to strengthen vendor risk management and data privacy.
Lead enterprise cybersecurity strategy as an executive team member, aligning risk management, data protection, and threat mitigation with institutional goals.
Serve as the primary cybersecurity advisor for executives and partners, translating threat intelligence and compliance requirements into actionable strategy.

experience.title: Executive Director of Technology (CIO / CTO / CISO)
experience.blurb: Unified IT, technology, and security as district CIO, CTO, and CISO, guiding the digital ecosystem for 3,700 staff and 24,000 students.

bullets.t: Managed an annual budget of more than $12 million and technology assets valued at more than $75 million.
Led the $12 million installation of Audio Enhancement safety and security systems across all 44+ school sites.
Reorganized a 40 person technology division, driving a 30% reduction in departmental spending ($1.5M in year one) by optimizing vendor contracts and eliminating external contractor dependencies.
Orchestrated a large scale core infrastructure overhaul (fiber, WAN/SD-WAN, firewalls, switches, routers) that doubled internet bandwidth and strengthened continuity against outages and cyber events.
Led the complete revamp and migration of Active Directory to Microsoft Entra ID.
Led the management, updating, and patching of more than 50,000 devices.
Established the district's first comprehensive cybersecurity program, aligned with NIST and CIS frameworks, protecting data for over 28,000 users.
Directed lifecycle management of 100,000 endpoints, migrating all imaging to a cloud based solution and reallocating staff to strategic initiatives.
Built partnerships with the Superintendent, Board, and leaders to align IT with academic goals and secure funding for key investments.
Deployed new analytics platforms and governance policies that gave department heads and executives actionable operational insights.

experience.title: Director of IT, Digital Learning, and Media Services
experience.blurb: Partnered with all departments to build and optimize a secure, modern digital ecosystem, leading the full lifecycle of technology solutions from implementation to enterprise wide adoption.

bullets.t: Served as a key strategic advisor to the Superintendent and executive leadership, authoring technology policies and administrative procedures.
Managed the lifecycle of over 100 information system products and an annual technology budget exceeding $2.5M.
Directed core platforms including the student information system and set interoperability standards for secure data exchange across 33,000 users.
Migrated and scaled three enterprise grade learning tools within a single week.
Oversaw the data privacy and governance program, reviewing over 250 vendor agreements annually.

bullets.h: NSA and US Cyber Command partnership
bullets.t: Pioneered a partnership with the National Security Agency and US Cyber Command to embed K12 NexGen Cyber standards across all curricula.
Launched a districtwide microcredentialing platform serving over 4,000 employees.
Led a team of 80 technology, instruction, and media specialists.

experience.title: IT Coordinator, Teacher, and Coach
experience.blurb: Championed instructional technology integration focused on empowering educators to differentiate instruction and develop higher order thinking for all learners.

bullets.t: Managed a Google Workspace environment serving over 3,700 users and directed technology training for over 200 staff members.
Created The Studio, a project based course blending Computer Science, AP Social Studies, and Language Arts.
Designed and taught virtual courses for Gwinnett Online Campus and Georgia Virtual School.
Led testing operations as assessment coordinator and developed course test banks used by the Georgia Department of Education.
Served as World History team lead for AP, Honors, and Technical students.

caseStudies.title: Talon Secure: a perfect CMMC Level 2 score
caseStudies.challenge: Researchers needed a place to store and work with Controlled Unclassified Information and export controlled (ITAR and EAR) data for DoD, DoE, and other federal research that would stand up to CMMC requirements.
caseStudies.approach: Led the GCC High research enclave with partner Planet Technologies: a segregated environment on Microsoft 365 GCC High and Azure Government with approved collaboration tools, protected storage, virtual desktops, and controlled communication. Drove the documentation, policies, control validation, mock assessments, and evidence needed for a C3PAO assessment.
caseStudies.result: A perfect score from a Certified Third Party Assessor Organization: 110 security controls tested against 320 assessment objectives, with no deficiencies in any of the 14 security categories. Faculty can now pursue larger Department of War grants and partner with defense companies.

quote.text: The assessment confirmed our protections are followed in practice, not just written down.
quote.by: Nic Carroll, quoted by Georgia Southern University

caseStudies.credit: The university's Research Security and Export Controls director credited Nic and his team with taking point on preparation.

caseStudies.result: A $12 million installation completed across all 44+ sites.

caseStudies.result: Greater visibility and faster resolution of threats and vulnerabilities, for a safe, secure, and reliable environment.

approach.title: Vision that gets finished

approach.title: On time, at scale, under budget

approach.title: Solve the real problem
approach.text: I look past symptoms to the problem underneath, then align people, budget, and technology to fix it.
